title: Design System: Grandma Buddy
source: docs/DESIGN.md (plain-English, no YAML frontmatter by project choice); token values are normative in static/styles.css :root and [data-time=night]

emergency-red.note: Emergency and Poison Control screens only; never in the normal app.

typographyMeta.family: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif (self-hosted woff2, SIL OFL 1.1, weights 200-800)

scale.note: Below the 22px body rule to fit four tabs; do not reuse.

shadows.name: key-edge
shadows.purpose: Raised white key: solid edge plus soft drop.

shadows.name: canister-edge
shadows.purpose: Canisters, edge in their own darker shade.

shadows.name: flat-plate
shadows.purpose: Buddy's face plate: soft drop, no edge, because it is not tappable.

motion.name: key-sink
motion.value: transform 0.1s ease-out; translateY(edge height), edge collapses to 0

motion.name: voice-ring
motion.purpose: Ring grows with her voice while listening.

motion.name: listen-pulse
motion.purpose: Dark dot on the plate while listening.

motion.name: step-back
motion.purpose: Everything except the plate fades while listening.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: all animation and transition off; ring fixed at 16px

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.note: two columns (talk | today), max 1040px; tab row max 720px

components.name: Raised Key
components.description: White pill key with a solid edge that sinks when pressed.
components.css: .ds-key { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; min-height:64px; padding:14px 24px; border:none; border-radius:999px; background:#FFFFFF; color:#0E2422; font:800 22px/1.5 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next','Segoe UI',sans-serif; box-shadow:0 6px 0 #B7CDCA, 0 12px 20px rgba(14,36,34,.22); transition:transform .1s ease-out, box-shadow .1s ease-out, filter .15s ease-out; cursor:pointer; } .ds-key:hover { filter:brightness(.95); } .ds-key:focus-visible { outline:5px solid #0E2422; outline-offset:5px; } .ds-key:active { transform:translateY(6px); box-shadow:0 0 0 #B7CDCA, 0 4px 8px rgba(14,36,34,.22); } .ds-glyph { color:#2A4A9C; }

components.name: Talk Plate
components.description: The biggest thing on screen: white plate, sunflower well, sinks 10px.
components.css: .ds-plate { width:240px; aspect-ratio:1; padding:0; border:none; border-radius:50%; background:#FFFFFF; display:grid; place-items:center; box-shadow:0 10px 0 #3A9E98, 0 20px 34px rgba(14,36,34,.22); transition:transform .1s ease-out, box-shadow .1s ease-out; cursor:pointer; } .ds-plate:focus-visible { outline:5px solid #0E2422; outline-offset:5px; } .ds-plate:active { transform:translateY(10px); box-shadow:0 0 0 #3A9E98, 0 8px 16px rgba(14,36,34,.22); } .ds-plate-face { width:82%; height:82%; border-radius:50%; background:#F7C23E; box-shadow:inset 0 -9px 0 #C99220; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:16px; color:#0E2422; font:800 30px/1.1 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next','Segoe UI',sans-serif; text-align:center; }

components.name: Canister
components.description: Feature-colored tappable block with a lid band; shamrock shown.
components.css: .ds-canister { position:relative; display:flex; align-items:flex-end; min-height:6.5rem; width:11rem; padding:28px 16px 16px; border:none; border-radius:20px 20px 28px 28px; background:#8DD39A; color:#0E2422; font:800 24px/1.15 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next','Segoe UI',sans-serif; text-align:left; box-shadow:0 7px 0 #4F9B5C, 0 14px 22px rgba(14,36,34,.22); transition:transform .1s ease-out, box-shadow .1s ease-out; cursor:pointer; } .ds-canister::before { content:''; position:absolute; top:0; left:0; right:0; height:16px; border-radius:20px 20px 0 0; background:#4F9B5C; box-shadow:0 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.12); } .ds-canister:focus-visible { outline:5px solid #0E2422; outline-offset:5px; } .ds-canister:active { transform:translateY(7px); box-shadow:0 0 0 transparent, 0 4px 8px rgba(14,36,34,.22); }

components.name: Reading Card
components.description: Flat white enamel card for reading, never tapping.
components.html:
Today's pills

No pills set up yet. Your family can add them.
components.css: .ds-note { background:#FFFFFF; color:#0E2422; border-radius:24px; padding:18px 22px 20px; font:400 22px/1.5 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next','Segoe UI',sans-serif; } .ds-note h2 { font-size:32px; font-weight:800; line-height:1.2; margin:0 0 8px; } .ds-note p { margin:0; color:#3A4F4D; }

components.name: Tab Bar
components.description: Fixed white bar with four tab keys; the open tab is sunflower.
components.html: <nav class="ds-tabbar"><button class="ds-tab ds-tab--on">Home</button><button class="ds-tab">Pills</button><button class="ds-tab">Diary</button><button class="ds-tab">Family</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-tabbar { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:16px; padding:12px 8px 16px; background:#FFFFFF; border-radius:28px 28px 0 0; box-shadow:0 -8px 24px rgba(14,36,34,.22); } .ds-tab { min-height:4.5rem; border:none; border-radius:20px; background:#EEF4F3; color:#0E2422; font:800 19px/1.2 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next','Segoe UI',sans-serif; box-shadow:0 5px 0 #B7CDCA; transition:transform .1s ease-out, box-shadow .1s ease-out; cursor:pointer; } .ds-tab--on { background:#F7C23E; box-shadow:0 5px 0 #C99220; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline:5px solid #0E2422; outline-offset:5px; } .ds-tab:active { transform:translateY(5px); box-shadow:0 0 0 transparent; }

narrative.overview: A cheerful 1950s-60s American kitchen: a tiled wall (turquoise by day, deep blue at night), white enamel plates and cards, and a solid-colored canister for each part of her day.
keyCharacteristics: Everything tappable is a raised key with a solid darker edge that sinks when pressed; things to read are flat.
Each feature keeps one color: sunflower talk, shamrock hurts, cobalt scams, lilac pills.
Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, extra bold on every key, 22px body minimum.
One authored motion moment: the voice ring and pulsing dot while listening; everything else fades back.
Red is reserved for emergency and Poison Control screens.

rules.name: The Raised Means Tappable Rule
rules.body: Only things she can tap get a solid edge and sink; reading cards and Buddy's face stay flat.

rules.name: The One Color Per Feature Rule
rules.body: A feature's color is the same everywhere it appears.

rules.name: The Red Means Emergency Rule
rules.body: No red in the normal app; red belongs only to emergency and Poison Control screens.

dos: Do keep body text at least 7:1 and buttons at least 4.5:1 against their background.
Do give every key an edge in a darker shade of its own color, and sink it by that edge height when pressed.
Do size drawings in em so they grow with Bigger words, and always put a word next to them.
donts: Don't use red outside the emergency and Poison Control screens.
Don't put an edge or shadow-key look on something that can't be tapped.
Don't reuse the 19px tab-name size anywhere else.
